landscape_pond.verification_scope: Visual mesh level/depth only; no physics or hydrology authority

optimization.method: Omit source BEVEL modifiers <=0.025 m in disposable export copy; triangulate shared copied reserve-tree meshes and delete only faces with geometric area <=1e-12 m²; preserve positions, visible silhouettes, UV/color/material layers, furniture and openings

reserve_tree_zero_area_cleanup.scope: Copied shared tree prototypes only; native meshes, terrain, trails and all instance poses unchanged

optimization.lod: Distance-selected authored near/far woodland meshes; shared forest meshes remain instanced. Core and reserve local-origin building prefabs supplied.

export_performance.unused_mesh_cleanup: Unused high-detail mesh IDs retained until disposable CLI exit; export remains selected objects in active scene only
export_performance.descendant_traversal: One cached parent-to-children snapshot and memoized geometry subtrees; prefab root detach preserves internal descendants; camera rig uses explicit selection

visibility_budget_note: Counts are loaded asset triangles, not measured on-screen triangles. Floor/room/cover groups allow the consumer to cull locally; no runtime occlusion, streaming or performance claim.
collision: Visual meshes only; no collision or navigation authority supplied
cutaway: Toggle only selected building Roof/FrontCover/UpperCover nodes; Interior remains present
portability: Core metallic-roughness PBR; embedded PNG images; geometry signs; no engine scripts required
